400.error: verify takes 1 or true to have the Mac check its copy again, or 0 or false (the same as leaving it out) for an ordinary prepare.

403.error: This device is paired for chat only. Pair it again with full control from Settings → Silicon Buddy on the Mac.

404.error: No phone model with that id. GET /ondevice/models lists the ones this Mac can fetch for a phone.

411.error: This server needs a Content-Length. Chunked bodies are not read.

413.error: That request body is larger than this device may send (4194304 bytes).

503.error: The drive “External SSD” that holds this Mac's model library is not connected, and the phone models are kept beside the library. Connect it and try again — the Mac will not put them on its startup disk instead.

507.error: There is not enough space for Gemma 4 E2B on the drive the phone models are kept on: it needs 3.3 GB, and 12.9 GB is free, of which 10.7 GB is kept free so a download cannot fill the drive. Free about 1.2 GB there, then try again.

swarm.error: A swarm node may not fetch or manage the models this Mac keeps for your phone. They are for the owner's own devices: pair one from Settings → Silicon Buddy.

summary: Have the Mac fetch the pinned file from Hugging Face and verify it. 202 with the entry while it is on its way — started now, resumed, or already running — and 200 once it is ready. Progress arrives on /events as `download` frames with the id `ondevice:<id>`. `?verify=1` has the Mac hash a ready copy again first: call it once when the file you fetched does not hash to `sha256`, then fetch from zero.
